items.title: Define topology critic role eligibility and independence policy
items.context: Only an eligible non-implementer may issue a critic verdict; identity and role separation must be mechanically verified rather than inferred from prompt prose.

items.title: Produce and verify signed hash-bound topology critic receipts
items.context: Bind critic receipts to current basis digest, topology digest, scope artifact digests, storyFilesHash, and closureFilesHash with deterministic freshness and tamper rejection.

items.title: Require independent approval for topology exclusions
items.context: Every exclusion approval must be independently attributable and cannot convert partial or unsupported discovery into a pass.

items.title: Prove critic and exclusion authority with adversarial production-path tests
items.context: Exercise self-authored, ineligible, stale, digest-tampered, scope-drifted, exclusion-forged, partial, and unsupported cases; exact restoration must pass and process-fact mutations must bite.
